title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2608.18656v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference with transformer models on CPUs is increasingly important, especially for Small Language Models (SLMs), where vector architectures are emerging as a promising execution substrate. The attention module is a major bottleneck due to high memory bandwidth requirements; FlashAttention mitigates this by fusing operations to improve data locality and reduce intermediate memory traffic. In this paper, we present FlashAttention-V, a blocked FlashAttention for scalable vector architectures that adapts efficiently from short to very long vectors by exploiting parallelism across attention heads, inter-head packing to enable efficient utilization of vector lengths beyond the head dimension, and improving vector register utilization and memory access locality. translated_title: 面向可扩展向量架构的FlashAttention
translated_abstract: 摘要：在CPU上进行变压器模型推理变得越来越重要，尤其是对于小型语言模型（SLM），其中向量架构正成为一种有前景的执行基础。注意力模块由于高内存带宽需求而成为主要瓶颈；FlashAttention通过融合操作来改善数据局部性并减少中间内存流量，从而缓解了这一问题。在本文中，我们提出了FlashAttention-V，一种用于可扩展向量架构的分块FlashAttention，它通过利用注意力头间的并行性、头间打包以有效利用超出头维度的向量长度，以及改进向量寄存器利用率和内存访问局部性，从而从短向量到极长向量高效适应。我们将FlashAttention-V集成到llama.cpp中的ggml中，并使用gem5和Banana Pi BPI-F3在TinyLlama、Llama 3.2、Qwen2.5和Pythia-410M上进行了评估。在Banana Pi BPI-F3上，我们...
tldr: 本文提出了FlashAttention-V，一种针对可扩展向量架构优化的分块注意力机制，通过跨注意力头并行和头间打包显著提升了CPU上小型语言模型推理的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces FlashAttention-V, a blocked attention mechanism optimized for scalable vector architectures, significantly improving CPU inference efficiency for small language models via cross-head parallelism and inter-head packing.
